notes: Official GitHub Copilot docs are the source of truth.
Repository hook files live in .github/hooks/*.json and are loaded by Copilot cloud agent and Copilot CLI.
Copilot CLI also supports user hook files under ~/.copilot/hooks/*.json, or $COPILOT_HOME/hooks/*.json when COPILOT_HOME is set.
Hook configuration files require top-level version: 1 and hooks.
Command hooks use bash, powershell, or command fields plus optional cwd, env, timeout, or timeoutSec.
Cloud agent honors bash and command entries inside its Linux sandbox and ignores powershell entries.
preToolUse denies through stdout JSON permissionDecision fields; it is fail-closed for command hook crashes and timeouts.
permissionRequest is Copilot CLI only and treats command hook exit code 2 as a deny.
notification is Copilot CLI only and does not fire under cloud agent.
Matchers are regexes anchored as ^(?:matcher)$ and must match the whole field value.

events.name: sessionStart
events.description: Runs when a new or resumed session begins.

events.name: userPromptSubmitted
events.description: Runs when the user submits a prompt.
events.cloud_agent: fires at most once for the job prompt

events.name: preToolUse
events.description: Runs before each tool executes and can allow, deny, ask, or modify args.

events.name: postToolUse
events.description: Runs after each successful tool execution.

events.name: postToolUseFailure
events.description: Runs after a tool completes with a failure.

events.name: agentStop
events.description: Runs when the main agent finishes a turn.

events.name: subagentStart
events.description: Runs when a subagent is spawned before it runs.

events.name: errorOccurred
events.description: Runs when an error occurs during agent execution.

events.name: permissionRequest
events.description: Copilot CLI only. Runs before the permission service and can allow or deny programmatically.

events.name: notification
events.description: Copilot CLI only. Runs asynchronously when the CLI emits a system notification.
